summary.headline: Timing the Native’s Fortune
summary.text: Chapter VIII explains how to determine the timing of a native’s fortune: oriental planets above Earth indicate fortune early in life, occidental planets below Earth late in life, while astrological houses and the Part of Fortune mark successive life stages. It also discusses benefics, malefics, luminaries, the lords of the Lunar triplicity, exaltations, domiciles, and planetary applications.
